description: Search Gumroad's marketplace by keyword, tag or category, pull a creator's public catalog, or enrich exact product URLs. No login, cookies or API key required.

category.description: Top-level Gumroad category to browse. Leave 'All categories' to search the whole marketplace.
category.title: Category

fileTypes.description: Only include products that ship at least one of these formats, e.g. pdf, zip, mp4, psd, epub, blend. In creator mode this reads product pages to verify formats.
fileTypes.title: Included file types

freeOnly.description: Only include products listed at price 0.
freeOnly.title: Free products only

includeDetails.description: Add full descriptions, file formats and sizes, variants, billing recurrences, refund policy, sales count, rating breakdown, creation/update dates and the USD price Gumroad displays.
includeDetails.sectionDescription: Optional enrichment reads extra public data. Detail mode adds one product-page request per product; reviews add one request per 10 reviews.
includeDetails.title: Read full product pages

includeReviews.description: Add public written reviews (rating, message, public rater display name, date, creator reply). Written reviews only; star-only ratings are counted in ratingCount.
includeReviews.title: Collect written reviews

includeSellerRecord.description: Also emit one seller record per unique creator. Seller records do not count toward Max items and are capped at 1,000 per run.
includeSellerRecord.title: Emit creator records

maxItems.description: Maximum product records to emit. Seller records are emitted on top of this cap.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Control how many product records a run can emit. Seller records are additional and do not count toward this cap.
maxItems.title: Max products

maxPrice.description: Maximum price in the product's own listed currency. Use 0 for free products only.
maxPrice.title: Maximum listed price

maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Upper limit for written reviews collected per product.
maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max reviews per product

minPrice.description: Minimum price in the product's own listed currency. Free products are 0. Use USD prices from details mode for cross-currency comparisons.
minPrice.title: Minimum listed price

minRating.description: Drop products rated below this value (0–5). Products without ratings are skipped when this is set.
minRating.title: Minimum average rating

mode.description: searchProducts searches Gumroad Discover. byProductUrls reads exact product pages in full. bySellerUrls reads every public product of a creator.
mode.sectionDescription: Choose how to find products. Search one or more keywords, browse tags or a category, enrich exact product URLs, or pull whole creator catalogs.
mode.title: Mode

monitorKey.description: Name of the saved snapshot. Use one key per search, storefront or product list you schedule.
monitorKey.title: Monitor key

monitorMode.description: When enabled, products unchanged since the last run with this key are skipped. First run emits everything.
monitorMode.sectionDescription: Schedule the same input and emit only products that are new or changed since the previous run under the same monitor key.
monitorMode.title: Monitor for new or changed products

nativeTypes.description: Only include these Gumroad product types: digital, course, ebook, membership, bundle, podcast, audiobook, newsletter, physical, commission, call, coffee, ticket. Leave empty for all types.
nativeTypes.sectionDescription: Narrow products by type, price, rating, pricing model, seller verification or included file format. Leave a filter empty to include everything.
nativeTypes.title: Product types

payWhatYouWantOnly.description: Only include products where the buyer can set the price.
payWhatYouWantOnly.title: Pay-what-you-want only

productUrls.description: Gumroad product links to read in full (mode=byProductUrls), e.g. https://creator.gumroad.com/l/product. Filters still apply.
productUrls.title: Product URLs

searchQueries.description: Keywords to search on Gumroad Discover (mode=searchProducts). One query per line, e.g. notion template, lightroom presets, vrchat avatar.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

sellerQuery.description: Optional text filter for mode=bySellerUrls. Keeps creator products whose name or permalink contains this text.
sellerQuery.title: Filter storefront products

sellerUrls.description: Gumroad creator stores to read in full (mode=bySellerUrls), e.g. https://creator.gumroad.com or https://gumroad.com/creator. Every public product in the store is collected once.
sellerUrls.title: Creator storefront URLs

sellerVerifiedOnly.description: Only include products from creators Gumroad marks as verified.
sellerVerifiedOnly.title: Verified creators only

sort.description: Gumroad's own result order for keyword, tag and category searches.
sort.title: Sort results

subcategory.description: Nested Gumroad category path that overrides Category, e.g. 3d/vrchat, design/icons, software-development/web-development.
subcategory.title: Subcategory path (optional)

tags.description: Gumroad Discover tags (mode=searchProducts). Multiple tags are combined with AND, e.g. notion and template.
tags.title: Tags

title: Gumroad Marketplace Search & Creator Catalog Input
